name: Daily notes
description: A note for each day, Journal/2026-10-05, made the first time something's written to it with just its date as its title. Open today's note, or step to the day before or after. Quick-add puts tasks in today's note, and ticking a repeating task logs it there.

files:read.why: Find the daily notes before and after the one you're on

files:write.why: Make today's note when you open it

daily.folder.description: The folder daily notes are in, each named by its date: Journal/2026-10-05.
